result.answer: Today the demo bed-management system keeps only the current location (W1). So the failed transfer to WARD-B (08:20 UTC, 15 Oct 2026) was closed with nothing sent. A later transfer to WARD-C, bed BAY1-07 (08:45 UTC), was already applied, and a resend would move the patient back. If the system had to keep every movement, the case would have gone to a person instead of closing. The fix would cancel the WARD-C transfer and replay both moves in order, ending on WARD-C again. That change would be a draft for a person to review on the Site profile page. Nothing is changed here. The members agree but stress different points. Impact warns that a replay changes the location several times, and Shutter cannot see how the bed board, pharmacy or porters would react. Encounter says Shutter cannot tell whether the site wants a full history. Conformance first leaned towards a resend because the message is well formed. It now accepts the closure.

perspectives.view: Closing keeps the record correct. Under full history, a replay would move the location several times, and Shutter cannot see how dependent systems would react, so a person would need to check them.
The WARD-B transfer no longer describes where the patient is, so closing was right today. Under full history the case would go to a person. Shutter cannot tell whether the site wants that.
The message is well formed, and the failure was the system being unavailable. It accepts the closure, and the message would be acceptable under either setting.

suggested_change.why: It would make this receiver keep every movement, so overtaken transfers go to a person. It is a draft for review on the Site profile page.
